display_title: Kissing Is a Violation of Contract
description:
She's finally got her shot at a nice job at one of the biggest companies around... working as the CEO's girlfriend?! Danbi hasn't been able to find work but has been getting by on a delivery job while looking for a more permanent arrangement. When she gets into her next interview, she realizes that she's just walked into a less-than-favorable reunion. Jae-Hyun, managing director of the company, is heading the interview. Just a day ago Danbi accidentally ruined his suit while chasing down a taxi, and now he wants compensation... for her to be his girlfriend in an elaborate contract. 3 Months. Danbi doesn't like the sound of it, but what other opportunity will she have for her resume...?
